unresolvedItems: Exact raw reference geometry heights, physical dimensions and optical properties remain uncalibrated.
Fine edge/section grain, local mottling and mobile framing still need visual refinement.
The current closed surface supports shallow geometric pits; through holes, overhangs and undercuts are unsupported.
The 28-tile sample shares time and history; it is not an approved construction layout or full roof generator.
Wet/dry rates, exposure factors and accumulated damage are illustrative_not_calibrated, not real aging predictions.
Studio controls separate enable, intensity and approximate Kelvin color; direction currently has group rotation rather than independent per-light angle UI.
The common strict schema and validator identity and complete shared-policy entry gates are still missing.
Complete old-project migration, all reference formats and performance across target devices have not all been independently verified in this turn.
